rationale: A legitimate and well-motivated decontamination test — the current-year tangible cushion mechanically embeds the very accrual build being measured, and lagging it breaks that identity — but it is a single-operator variant of an existing archive signal, so it is diagnostic value rather than new economics.

This is the third deflator permutation of the same breakeven gate (pi/lt, pi/at, pi/VOL(ni)) and the proposal's own reasoning frames it as "the last remaining clean deflator experiment," which is exactly the cosmetic-variant search the objective warns against; it also introduces a fragile denominator for the many firms with near-zero interest-bearing debt.

Asset turnover decay is a genuinely untested conditioning dimension in this archive — operational rather than financing or reporting-incentive based — and the three-year trend form correctly distinguishes persistent productivity decay from the transitory sales-growth conditioner that already failed, though it will partly overlap with the successful TREND(lt/sale) gate.

The one-sided benchmark-beating asymmetry is a real economic claim from the earnings-management literature and the expression matches the hypothesis, but zeroing all loss firms creates a large mass point at exactly zero that will dilute the middle of the cross-section and makes the result partly a sample-restriction artifact rather than a cleaner mechanism.

Using a signed IND_ZSCORE as a multiplicative gate flips the sign of the accrual leg for every below-peer-capital-intensity firm, so the composite predicts that high accrual builds earn *higher* returns in asset-light firms — a claim the hypothesis never makes and that contradicts the baseline accrual effect; RANK of the industry z-score would implement the stated economics without the reversal.

The contemporaneous borrowing-minus-earnings funding gap is a genuinely new flow-based gate relative to the archive's stock, trend and maturity conditioners, but DELTA(lt) contains the change in payables that enters the accrual leg with the opposite sign — the exact contamination the archive already diagnosed when moving to interest-bearing debt — and the construct also risks rediscovering the net-external-financing anomaly.
